completion_rule: An item is complete only when every listed runtime route has exact C-oracle evidence. Missing, compile-only, pending, fallback, or stale evidence is debt.

ownership_rules.subject: custom library memory
ownership_rules.rule: FT_New_Library retains the caller memory object and every allocation and release uses its callbacks through final library destruction.

ownership_rules.subject: memory face source bytes
ownership_rules.rule: FT_New_Memory_Face borrows the caller byte range for the complete face lifetime and FT_Done_Face releases only face-owned state.

ownership_rules.subject: external streams
ownership_rules.rule: FT_Open_Face retains caller-owned external stream identity and invokes the configured close callback without freeing caller storage.

ownership_rules.subject: face child records
ownership_rules.rule: A face owns its glyph slot, active size records, and charmaps; the child pointers remain borrowed and face-scoped.

ownership_rules.subject: size records
ownership_rules.rule: FT_New_Size creates a face-owned size and FT_Done_Size removes and frees exactly that record.

ownership_rules.subject: slot bitmap promotion
ownership_rules.rule: FT_GlyphSlot_Own_Bitmap copies borrowed bitmap bytes once, marks ownership, and preserves already-owned or non-bitmap slots.

ownership_rules.subject: bitmap records
ownership_rules.rule: Bitmap copy, conversion, emboldening, and done replace or release target buffers with the pinned allocator and leave exact public state.

ownership_rules.subject: outline owner flag
ownership_rules.rule: FT_OUTLINE_OWNER controls whether outline destruction releases point, tag, and contour storage.

ownership_rules.subject: outline glyph
ownership_rules.rule: FT_Get_Glyph deep-copies slot outline arrays into a caller-owned FT_OutlineGlyph.

ownership_rules.subject: bitmap glyph
ownership_rules.rule: FT_Get_Glyph deep-copies bitmap storage into a caller-owned FT_BitmapGlyph.

ownership_rules.subject: glyph destruction
ownership_rules.rule: FT_Done_Glyph releases each public glyph allocation exactly once without requiring the source face to remain active.

ownership_rules.subject: glyph bitmap conversion
ownership_rules.rule: FT_Glyph_To_Bitmap preserves or destroys the source according to destroy and transfers the replacement glyph only after successful rendering.

ownership_rules.subject: custom glyph renderer
ownership_rules.rule: FT_New_Glyph allocates the renderer-selected public glyph class and transfers the resulting object to the caller.

ownership_rules.subject: stroker exports
ownership_rules.rule: Stroker export and glyph-stroke operations preserve the documented source and destination ownership choices.

ownership_rules.subject: variation descriptors
ownership_rules.rule: FT_Get_MM_Var returns one library-owned allocation graph that FT_Done_MM_Var releases with the same library.

ownership_rules.subject: cache manager
ownership_rules.rule: FTC_Manager owns requested faces, sizes, caches, and evictable nodes until reset or done.

ownership_rules.subject: cache node references
ownership_rules.rule: Cache lookup transfers an optional node reference and FTC_Node_Unref releases exactly that reference.

ownership_rules.subject: incremental glyph data
ownership_rules.rule: Incremental get_glyph_data output is released through free_glyph_data after the consumer finishes and not before.

ownership_rules.subject: OpenType validation tables
ownership_rules.rule: FT_OpenType_Validate transfers selected table buffers to the caller and FT_OpenType_Free releases them through face memory.

ownership_rules.subject: GX validation tables
ownership_rules.rule: FT_TrueTypeGX_Validate transfers selected table buffers and FT_TrueTypeGX_Free releases each returned buffer.

ownership_rules.subject: classic kern validation table
ownership_rules.rule: FT_ClassicKern_Validate transfers one validation buffer and FT_ClassicKern_Free releases it with face memory.

ownership_rules.subject: compressed stream wrappers
ownership_rules.rule: Compressed wrappers own their decompressor state but never close or free the caller-owned source stream.

ownership_rules.subject: module classes
ownership_rules.rule: The library owns installed module records while callback function pointers and class data obey the add, remove, and final-destruction lifetime.

state_transitions.subject: library reference lifecycle
state_transitions.rule: initialize, reference, non-final done, final done

state_transitions.subject: face reference lifecycle
state_transitions.rule: open, reference, decrement, final release

state_transitions.subject: size lifecycle
state_transitions.rule: create, activate, mutate metrics, switch, remove

state_transitions.subject: glyph slot lifecycle
state_transitions.rule: empty, load, transform, render, replace

state_transitions.subject: charmap state
state_transitions.rule: enumerate, select or set, expose active charmap, reject foreign charmap

state_transitions.subject: variation coordinate state
state_transitions.rule: set full, partial, excess, reset, named instance, then observe coordinates and glyph output

state_transitions.subject: Adobe MM coordinate state
state_transitions.rule: set design, blend, weight vector, reset, then observe coordinates and glyph output

state_transitions.subject: palette state
state_transitions.rule: select palette, mutate foreground, reselect and reset

state_transitions.subject: module registry
state_transitions.rule: empty library, add defaults, add custom, lookup, replace, remove, final destroy

state_transitions.subject: renderer state
state_transitions.rule: discover renderer, select renderer, invoke raster callbacks, remove or destroy

state_transitions.subject: cache manager state
state_transitions.rule: create, lookup, hit, reference, reset, evict, done

state_transitions.subject: stroker state
state_transitions.rule: new, set, rewind, begin path, add segments, end path, export, done

state_transitions.subject: external stream state
state_transitions.rule: open, read, seek, frame enter and exit, close

state_transitions.subject: gzip stream state
state_transitions.rule: open, read forward, seek backward, close wrapper

state_transitions.subject: LZW stream state
state_transitions.rule: open, read forward, seek backward, close wrapper

state_transitions.subject: bzip2 stream state
state_transitions.rule: open, read forward, close wrapper without closing source

state_transitions.subject: validator state
state_transitions.rule: initialize, validate selected tables, transfer buffers, free buffers, clean partial failure

state_transitions.subject: incremental callback state
state_transitions.rule: store interface, acquire glyph data, seed and override metrics, release glyph data

state_transitions.subject: property state
state_transitions.rule: set, get, default reset, face-scoped override and observable glyph effect

state_transitions.subject: debug hook state
state_transitions.rule: install, replace, ignore invalid index, preserve public hook table

binary_artifacts.subject: versioned include and library installation layout
